SELECT ug.subject_id AS subjectId, e.id AS exam_id, e.title AS exam_title, g.subject_name, MAX(ues.user_score) AS max_score, MIN(ues.user_score) AS min_score, AVG(ues.user_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(ues.user_id) AS attendNum FROM t_exam e JOIN t_exam_subject ug ON e.id = ug.exam_id JOIN t_user_exams_score ues ON e.id = ues.exam_id and ues.whether_mark in (-1,1) JOIN t_user u ON ues.user_id = u.id JOIN t_subject g ON ug.subject_id = g.id
e.is_deleted = 0 and ues.user_id IS NOT NULL
and ug.subject_id = #{subjectId}
and e.title like concat('%',#{examTitle},'%')
and g.id in
#{uId}
GROUP BY ug.subject_id, e.id, e.title

select u.id as userId, u.real_name as userName, e.title as examTitle, ues.limit_time, ues.exam_id, case ues.whether_mark when 1 then '是' when 0 then '否' end as corrected from t_user_exams_score as ues left join t_user as u on ues.user_id = u.id left join t_exam as e on ues.exam_id = e.id where ues.exam_id = #{examId} and ues.whether_mark = 0
and u.real_name like concat('%',#{realName},'%')
